gloss: item in good condition; beautiful specimen

definitions.explanation: A secondhand or collectible item that is in excellent condition with minimal signs of use. Commonly used in online marketplace listings and auction sites.

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}は{美品|びひん}です。
examples.english: This book is in excellent condition.

examples.japanese: {美品|びひん}の{中古|ちゅうこ}カメラを{安|やす}く{手|て}に{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I got a used camera in great condition for a low price.

examples.japanese: フリマアプリで「{美品|びひん}」と{書|か}いてあっても、{届|とど}いたら{傷|きず}だらけだったことがある。
examples.english: Even when it says 'excellent condition' on the flea market app, there have been times when the item arrived covered in scratches.

notes:
USAGE:
{美品|びひん} is extremely common in Japanese online marketplaces like メルカリ (Mercari), ヤフオク (Yahoo Auctions), and ラクマ (Rakuma). It indicates that a secondhand item has been well cared for and shows little wear.

CONDITION SCALE (common in listings):
- {新品|しんぴん}: brand new
- {未使用|みしよう}: unused
- {美品|びひん}: excellent condition
- {良品|りょうひん}: good condition
- {難|なん}あり: has flaws/defects
- ジャンク: junk, for parts

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美品|びひん}の{中古|ちゅうこ}〜 (secondhand ~ in excellent condition)
- {美品|びひん}をお{探|さが}しの{方|かた} (for those looking for items in excellent condition)
- {状態|じょうたい}は{美品|びひん} (condition is excellent)
